message: 絶景

name: Nanaka
message: 「Gaaah, where on earth is this place!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Anywhere's fine, it's all the same~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No it's not! Misa told me there's a spot with a breathtaking view right along our way to school!」

name: Synn
message: 「...? Hey, what are you two up to together?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, Synn! Great timing--mind giving us a hand?」

name: Synn
message: 「With what?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「There's supposed to be a spot around here where the sunset looks super pretty!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「The Vice President told Nana-chan about it~」

name: Synn
message: 「On this road we take every day? Hmm, nothing comes to mind...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Right? I've been looking for a while now, and I can't find it anywhere」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ahahaha, I should've properly asked Misa for the exact location」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You could just call the Vice President on your cell~」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, that's the surest way.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「F-Finding it on my own makes the payoff way more moving!」

name: Synn
message: 「...You're just too embarrassed about forgetting to ask to call her, aren't you?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「*Gulp*!?」
I don't know what kind of conversation Nanaka and Misa had, but it doesn't seem like she's being pranked.
However, the school path runs along the base of the mountain, and while it sits higher than the residential area, the overgrown trees block the view.

name: Synn
message: 「If the view's that good, I'd like to see it too」

name: Sacchin
message: 「There's a wonderful view right here~? Look, look, right here, right here~」

name: Synn
message: 「Where are you talking about?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Right inside here--Nana-chan's skirt, flip~♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Gyaaaaaaaaah!!?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-Nanaka's panties... *Pffft*, nosebleed booster」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa, Synn fainted from the shock」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ufufu, I see. So you do see me as a girl after all」

name: Sacchin
message: 「What a magnificent view, what a magnificent view」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, how long are you gonna keep holding it up?! Put it down already」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh, ugh, a giant panty demon is attacking me...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ugh... What does Synn even think of me...?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Maybe the incarnation of panties?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No way, I don't wanna be that!」
As my consciousness fades away, I can hear Nanaka and Sacchin's voices.
To me, Nanaka is...
